minimaxTts.configuration.title: MiniMax TTS
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.apiH: MiniMax API host URL. Must use HTTPS. Defaults to the global endpoint https://api.minimax.io.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.mode: MiniMax speech synthesis model. HD generally offers higher quality; Turbo is faster.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.voic: Default voice ID. You can use MiniMax built-in voices, cloned voices, or any voice ID available to your account.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.role: Voice IDs per character type for the "Speak Document with Character Voices" command. Keys: narrator, male, female, girl, boy, child, elderly. Specific characters can be reassigned in the confirmation step of that command.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.form: Output audio format. HTTP non-streaming supports mp3, wav, and flac.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.chan: Audio channels. 1 for mono, 2 for stereo.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.lang: Language boost. Use auto for unknown languages.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.pron: Pronunciation dictionary tone array, e.g. Omg/Oh my god. Not sent when empty.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.voic: Enable voice_modify parameters for voice changing / sound effects.
voice_modify.pitch, voice changing pitch. Only sent when voice_modify is enabled.
voice_modify.intensity, voice changing intensity. Only sent when voice_modify is enabled.
voice_modify.timbre, timbre variation. Only sent when voice_modify is enabled.
voice_modify.sound_effects, sound effect name, e.g. spacious_echo. Not sent when empty.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.subt: Whether to request subtitle timestamp info. The extension currently focuses on audio playback and does not display subtitles, but the parameter is forwarded to MiniMax.
Subtitle granularity. HTTP non-streaming recommends sentence or word.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.extr: Advanced MiniMax T2A request parameters. Use for newly added or unexposed fields, e.g. timbre_weights. Core fields (model, text, stream, output_format, voice_setting, audio_setting) are preserved by the extension.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.cach: Whether to reuse cached audio for identical text and parameters.
Maximum audio cache size in MB. Set to 0 to disable size-based cleanup.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.maxT: [Common] Maximum characters per TTS request. Exceeding this prompts the user to select shorter text.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.requ: [Common] TTS request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for slower networks.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.brow: [Common] Browser executable path for the external player. Leave blank to auto-detect Chrome/Edge/Brave.
Use MiniMax TTS to convert the provided text to speech and play it in VS Code. Only use when the user explicitly requests speaking, reading aloud, playing, narrating, or text-to-speech. This tool consumes MiniMax quota or account balance and will play audio in the user's editor; do not use for general explanations or summaries.
The text to convert to speech and play.
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.role: [Multi-role] AI source for role analysis. Copilot models use your VS Code Copilot configured models without extra API keys. OpenAI-compatible API requires your own key to connect to third-party services like DeepSeek.
[Multi-role · Copilot] Full model ID of the selected model for role analysis. Use the "Configure Role Analysis" command for an easier selection experience.
[Multi-role · OpenAI] OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for role analysis, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com. Used to analyze characters and dialogue in text for multi-role playback.
[Multi-role · OpenAI] Model name for role analysis, e.g. deepseek-chat.

[Multi-role] Custom role analysis prompt. Replaces the entire default prompt when set. Supports placeholders: {{text}} (text chunk), {{knownCharacters}} (known characters JSON), {{strictReminder}} (retry reminder), {{emotions}} (emotion list), {{toneTags}} (tone tag list), {{unknownSpeaker}} (unknown speaker name).
minimaxTts.configuration.properties.soun: [Multi-role] Background sound effects library directory. Subdirectories serve as scene categories. During multi-role playback, the text scene is automatically analyzed and matched to the corresponding category.
